deck.caption:
Think a 7% Fixed Deposit is safely growing your money? Think again.

Here is the brutal math for anyone in the 30% tax bracket:

• Gross FD Return: 7.0%
• Post-Tax Return (30% Tax): 4.9%
• Headline Inflation: 6.0%
• Actual Real Return: -1.04%

Every year your money sits in an FD, you are losing purchasing power to taxation and inflation.

Want to protect your wealth from silent financial leaks?

Comment 'GUIDE' below and I'll DM you 'The Retail Risk Checklist' for free.

#FixedDeposit #PersonalFinanceIndia #Investing #FinancialLiteracy #MarketDebunk #Inflation
